raw_evidence_archive.contents: Healthy and completed-trial original JUnit plans, traces, raw JaCoCo, logs, checkpoint and independent audit; interrupted active trial excluded

source_review: The original test holds FSNamesystem.readLock around Saver.save (TestFSImageWithSnapshot.java:143-155). Snapshot creation changes SnapshotManager.numSnapshots under FSNamesystem.writeLock (FSNamesystem.java:7175-7192). Saver serializes the in-memory snapshot list and compares its count with that manager count (FSImageFormatPBSnapshot.java:435-468). A checked IOException at writeDelimitedTo aborts serialization before the guard; heartbeat/RPC faults do not modify the locked snapshot count. The selected equality was true in every fault-retaining trace. This site is outside the current checked-I/O fault model for ad hoc coordination in this unchanged JUnit, so the campaign was source-excluded rather than reported as a negative bug proof.
